text: 5-day-old male newborn. The newborn's mother reports that her child has developed yellowish discoloration of the skin that started from the face and then spread to the trunk since the past day. speaker: Doctor
text: The jaundice appearing after the first 24 hours and spreading from face to trunk is consistent with physiological or breast milk jaundice, but we must rule out pathology. Is the baby feeding well, and has he had at least six wet diapers and three stools in the last 24 hours?
